incidents.name: Unizen Trade Aggregator arbitrary call in swap
incidents.notes: A newly upgraded swap entrypoint on the Unizen Trade Aggregator proxy executed an attacker-supplied (target, calldata) Call without whitelisting the target, so transferFrom calls were forwarded to arbitrary ERC-20s and drained every wallet that still had an allowance to the aggregator.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0xd3f64BAa732061F8B3626ee44bab354f854877AC created 2022-09-27 by 0xdbc320a510bcf1a8368ca38fc3ad773e259ced26, not the attacker; ten EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 19391308 on 2024-03-08T15:21:35Z installing implementation 0xa051fc7d38baa0ace811ad9de4e9f7024e5d8a30 — 8.5 hours before the incident — so codeAge is measured from that upgrade, not from the 2022 deployment. src/test/2024-03/UnizenIO2_exp.sol covers a second drain transaction (0xdd0636e2598f4d7b74f364fedb38f334365fd956747a04a6dd597444af0bc1c0) against the same proxy and is not recorded separately.
